criteria.description: A readable workbook opens and the source inputs, assumptions, scenarios, and results are identifiable without relying on sheet names.
Policy coal generation applies the documented displacement rate to the protected source value.
Policy wind and solar generation apply their documented uplift schedules.
Natural gas starts from the supplied historical base and closes the policy balance while Other generation stays constant.
Policy emissions use GWh × 1,000 × tCO2/MWh, match the independent replay, and remain formula-linked.
The reported result calculates absolute emissions reduction from the two scenarios.
The reported result calculates emissions-intensity reduction from the two scenarios.
Changing the coal-displacement assumption updates coal, gas, policy emissions, and emissions reduction to the replayed values.
Coal, gas, wind, solar, and explicit or implied Other generation balance to demand in both cases.
Emissions respond to the protected coal and gas factors through workbook formulas and preserve the GWh-to-MWh conversion.
Historical generation, demand, and emissions-factor inputs remain unchanged.
A distinct policy-demand-growth perturbation updates demand, balancing gas, emissions, intensity, and reported results while preserving source generation and the coal/renewable policy schedule.

review_notes.purpose_zh: 检查基准与政策情景、发电量平衡、排放量、排放强度和 GWh 到 MWh 的单位换算。
review_notes.answer_location_zh: 本 rubric 只对应修正后的题面和输入，按能源类型、情景标签和平衡关系查找结果。
accepted_equivalents_zh: 合理的工作表名和布局
review_notes.not_scoreable_zh: 历史答卷来自来源和单位定义冲突的旧题，统一记为题目版本不可比，不用修正版 rubric 重新打分。
review_notes.known_limit_zh: 修正版还没有让三套系统重新运行，因此当前没有可比的新分数。
review_notes.reporting_zh: 当前对外只使用 0 至 1 的连续分数和分项结果；hurdle_criteria 和 pass_threshold 仅为旧运行接口保留。
